findings.reason: Approved as one note/debrief editing, approval, share/unshare and uncertain-attempt presentation. Distinct wire response semantics reside in artifacts/contracts.ts; network dispatch and uncertainty classification reside in artifacts/api.ts; captured actor/lifetime and cache-local attempt ownership reside in useArtifactMutation.ts. The view delegates preview/generation to existing public modules and does not own backend authority, provider calls or persistent artifact content.

Approved as one saved-artifact row rendering its confidentiality/share state, body or restricted placeholder, and existing edit/approve/share/unshare/preview affordances. It passes deliberate actions to the canonical parent mutation and does not duplicate transport or lifecycle logic.

Approved as one meeting draft form: local client choice, local timezone conversion and validation, field presentation and pending/uncertain field locks. Native persisted input matching is owned by meeting-save.ts; actor/lifetime and response handling by mutations.ts. The final locks keep the submitted snapshot stable and add no unrelated responsibility.

Approved as one destination-choice dialog, preserving trim/null semantics and draft presentation. File authority, same-file serialization, semantic receipts and explicit current-state recovery are delegated to the metadata hook/actions; reusable status rendering is separate. No unrelated subsystem or speculative abstraction added.
